_note: Every constant used by the experiments. Each entry names its source. Values marked assumption are choices of this paper, stated in the text.

life_years.source: Five-year service life, the warranty period used by Lachesis (arXiv:2610.08378) and the ROAR preprint

stacks_per_node.source: assumption: one HBF stack per GPU on an 8-GPU node, as in the ROAR preprint

slc_stack_bytes.source: 512 GiB per stack: the OCP HBF base-die specification v0.7.0 density (16 dies of 256 Gib); the spec names no cell type, and HBF papers treat the stack as SLC

bits_per_cell.source: definition; equal die count means capacity scales with bits per cell (assumption)

source.slc: assumed by Yu et al. (arXiv:2609.39131), Baek et al. (arXiv:2609.25782), Lachesis (arXiv:2610.08378), Peng et al. (arXiv:2609.07175)
source.pslc_low: Virtium vendor rating for pSLC on 3D TLC, as cited in the ROAR preprint
source.tlc: upper end of the 1,000-3,000 range cited in the ROAR preprint
source.qlc: about 1,000 cycles under sequential writes (Tai et al., cited in the ROAR preprint)

stack_read_bytes_per_s.source: 1.6 TB/s first-generation HBF read bandwidth target (Sandisk; xenospectrum.com/en/hbf-ocp-specification)

pcie_bytes_per_s.source: PCIe Gen5 x16, about 63 GB/s per direction (Yu et al., arXiv:2609.39131)

host_dram_bytes_per_node.source: 16 DDR5 channels x 64 GB (Yu et al., arXiv:2609.39131)

ssd_bytes_per_node.source: 32 SSDs x 1 TB (Yu et al., arXiv:2609.39131)

ssd_bytes_per_s.source: 8 GB/s per SSD (Yu et al., arXiv:2609.39131)

ssd_dwpd_examples.source: assumption: two example ratings, expressed as drive writes per day over a five-year life

gpu_flops.source: NVIDIA B200 2.25 PFLOP/s dense BF16 at 50% utilization (ROAR preprint, model.py)

block_tokens.source: block size of the Mooncake and converted Qwen-Bailian traces

models.source: ROAR preprint model.py: Llama-3.1-70B GQA, 80 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 x 2 bytes x 2; DeepSeek-V3 MLA, 61 layers x 576 values x 2 bytes

hbm_blocks.source: ROAR preprint: about 1 TB of HBM KV cache per node (6,000 Llama blocks; equal bytes for DeepSeek-V3)

write_all_files.source: ROAR simulator outputs: bytes per day HBM evicts on the tool-and-agent day (write-all), 1 TB HBM per node

tracelab.source: TraceLab blog (syfi.cs.washington.edu/blog/2026-06-25-tracelab/): mean 46.7 min, median about 1.4 min between a user's requests

wildchat_file.source: WildChat-1M shards 0-2, gaps between consecutive assistant turns (ROAR preprint)

ssd_pool.source: 32 SSDs x 1 TB (Yu et al.); 3 DWPD is an example rating (assumption); a block crosses the 63 GB/s PCIe link

dram_sweep_bytes.source: 1 TB (Yu et al.); 2 TB default and 4 TB maximum system memory of an NVIDIA DGX B200 (assumption to be checked against the datasheet)
